audits.claim: A rejected SendGrid cancellation aborts the remaining cancellation loop and prevents all queued reminder deletions from executing.
audits.evidence: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:225-231 marks an existing scheduled email cancelled, and packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:44-51 selects those rows when due within an hour. For selected rows A, B and C, if A cancels successfully and B has a rejected request (for example a transient connection failure), the await at scheduleEmailReminders.ts:57-64 transfers control to the single catch at :75-77 before C is attempted. A's Prisma delete is only collected at :66-72; Promise.all at :74, which would execute the lazy deletes, is skipped, so A and B remain recorded and C remains scheduled remotely for the cancelled booking. A subsequent successful run can recover, but there is no per-row isolation or guaranteed retry before delivery; permanent rejection of repeat cancellations is an additional service-dependent possibility, not needed to establish the defect.

audits.claim: The outer rescheduling try/catch cannot catch failures from the asynchronous reminder cancellation helpers.
audits.evidence: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:746-773 loads workflowReminders as a Prisma relation array, ruling out the ordinary missing-array failure before the loop. At :964-974, forEach discards both helpers' promises, so asynchronous failures cannot reach the outer catch. Moreover emailReminderManager.ts:202-235 and smsReminderManager.ts:177-189 already catch and log their own cancellation errors. The outer catch is therefore redundant for the supported call path; removing it changes no successful cancellation behavior.

audits.claim: Unawaited SMS cancellation can attempt to delete a reminder already removed by workflow or step cascade deletion, producing a misleading error log.
audits.evidence: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/workflows.tsx:212-225 starts SMS cancellation without awaiting it and then deletes the workflow; :519-531 does the same before deleting a step. smsReminderManager.ts:179-186 awaits the Twilio cancellation before issuing a single-row reminder delete, while schema.prisma:587 and :643 cascade workflow deletion through steps to reminders. If the cascade completes while Twilio is pending, the subsequent single-row delete finds no record and the helper logs its caught error at smsReminderManager.ts:187-188, despite successful cancellation. The comment overstates frequency: if the SMS row delete wins, deleting its parent later does not fail because an already absent child is harmless; the confirmed impact is conditional log noise, not lost data.

audits.claim: The workflow router retains an unused Prisma import, imports PrismaPromise as a value despite only type usage, and includes unrelated formatting churn.
audits.evidence: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/workflows.tsx:1-10 imports Prisma and PrismaPromise as values, but Prisma has no usage elsewhere and PrismaPromise is only used in the type annotation at :342-349. packages/config/eslint-preset.js:24 flags unused imports and :42-49 requires separate type imports, supporting the proposed cleanup without establishing a runtime defect. The supplied diff also shows the removed trailing comma at workflows.tsx:9 and indentation-only changes in the block comment at :901-961. These are lint/formatting and review-noise concerns.
